A '''ventrator washer''' was an engineering component used aboard [[starship]]s. While [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] on the [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] ''[[Colders Watch]]'', [[Dirk Harkness]] carried several in his pocket.
